text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Looking ahead to the Japanese Derby, 
Duramente asked to increase her mock 
races. It was her way of countering her 
habit of getting overly worked up.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
However, in my view, the primary cause 
appeared to be her narrowed field of 
vision. What she needed was training to 
broaden her perspective.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Just as reacting to a call during the 
Satsuki Sho expanded her field of view, 
she trains to broaden her senses... and 
"connect" with the world.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
She asked Neo Universe for guidance. 
Through meditation and waterfall ascetism, 
Duramente successfully managed to 
"connect" with the world.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
She has learned to view her races from a 
bird's-eye perspective. She will likely 
never suffer from tunnel vision again. We 
can look forward to seeing her strongest 
running style at the Japanese Derby.
